en.summary: This one-page affidavit states that a process server personally delivered the summons, complaint, and related court materials for GTV Media Group Inc. to Mack Robertson at a New York address on May 24, 2021. Robertson reportedly said he was authorized to accept service for the entity. This is sworn proof offered to establish service; it is not a ruling on liability or the merits.
en.plainEnglish: This document is a delivery receipt under oath. It records who says the papers were handed over, when, where, and to whom. It does not decide whether the plaintiffs' claims are true, and a court could still be asked to decide whether the method of service was legally sufficient.
legalReading: The affiant identifies himself as an adult nonparty and states that service occurred at 10:36 a.m. on May 24, 2021 at 162 East 64th Street, New York.
The listed papers include the summons, complaint, civil cover sheet, Judge Schofield's COVID-19 practices and civil rules, and electronic-filing instructions.
The affidavit identifies Mack Robertson as the recipient and reports that he was security and authorized to accept service on GTV Media Group Inc.'s behalf.
An affidavit of service is evidence of service. This filing does not itself adjudicate contested service, personal jurisdiction, liability, damages, or any allegation in the complaint.
caseConnections: Read with the complaint and any later motion challenging service or jurisdiction to determine whether service became disputed.
Keep this entity-specific service record separate from service on other defendants and from any later clerk's default or default judgment.
whyItMatters: Valid service ordinarily starts the served party's response period and is a prerequisite to many later default procedures.
The date, recipient, authority, and address are the key facts to compare with the docket and any service challenge.
verificationTasks: Confirm Doc 12 and its filing date against PACER or the RECAP docket.
Review any later filing that accepts, waives, or contests service on GTV Media Group Inc.
riskFlags: The page was recovered through OCR; portions of the header, signature, and license field are unclear.
The process server's sworn statement is not a judicial finding that service was legally sufficient.
Service does not establish liability or the truth of the complaint.

findings.text: The affidavit reports personal delivery of specified case papers for GTV Media Group Inc. to Mack Robertson on May 24, 2021.
Robertson is described as security who stated he was authorized to accept service for the entity.
The filing records a sworn service account but contains no judicial determination of service validity or case merits.

zh.summary: 这份一页送达宣誓书称，送达人于 2021 年 5 月 24 日在纽约一处地址，将传票、起诉状及相关法院材料亲自交给 Mack Robertson，以完成对 GTV Media Group Inc. 的送达。文件称 Robertson 表示自己获授权代表该实体接受送达。这是用于证明送达的宣誓证据，不是关于责任或案件实体问题的裁决。
zh.plainEnglish: 可以把它理解成一张经过宣誓的“法律文件签收记录”：谁在什么时间、什么地点，把哪些文件交给了谁。它不说明原告的主张是真是假；如果有人提出异议，法院仍可能需要判断这种送达方式在法律上是否有效。
legalReading: 宣誓人说明自己是成年非当事人，并称 2021 年 5 月 24 日上午 10:36 在纽约东 64 街 162 号实施送达。
所列文件包括传票、起诉状、民事封面表、Schofield 法官的疫情期间规则和民事规则，以及电子提交说明。
文件把 Mack Robertson 列为收件人，并称其为保安且获授权代表 GTV Media Group Inc. 接受送达。
送达宣誓书属于送达证据；它本身不裁判送达争议、人身管辖权、责任、损害赔偿或起诉状中的任何指控。
caseConnections: 应与起诉状及后续任何质疑送达或管辖权的动议一起阅读，确认送达后来是否成为争议。
这份针对特定实体的送达记录应与其他被告的送达、书记官缺席登记和缺席判决分别记录。
whyItMatters: 有效送达通常会启动被送达方的回应期限，也是许多后续缺席程序的前提。
送达日期、收件人、授权依据和地址，是与案卷及任何送达异议核对的核心信息。
verificationTasks: 通过 PACER 或 RECAP 案卷核对 Doc 12 及其提交日期。
检查后续文件中是否有接受、放弃或质疑对 GTV Media Group Inc. 送达的内容。
riskFlags: 本页通过 OCR 恢复，页眉、签名和执照号码字段有部分字符不清。
送达人的宣誓陈述不等于法院已经认定送达在法律上有效。
完成送达不等于被告承担责任，也不证明起诉状内容属实。

findings.text: 宣誓书称，2021 年 5 月 24 日已把列明的案件文件交给 Mack Robertson，以送达 GTV Media Group Inc.。
文件把 Robertson 描述为保安，并记载其表示自己获授权代表该实体接受送达。
该文件记录送达人的宣誓陈述，但没有法院对送达有效性或案件实体问题的裁判。
